text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Two hot spring buns, please.
One with smooth bean paste, and one with coarse.

text_block_list.name: Manju Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, miss.
Careful now, it's hot.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.
With the Twinkle Series winding down and some free time on our hands, we had come on the hot springs trip we previously won in the lottery.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: An aimless journey, guided only by whim.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Indeed, traveling once in a while is rather pleasant. Stopping you back then was truly the right decision.

Truth be told, when the exact dates for the "hot springs trip"
were decided, she had formulated a meticulous schedule
so as not to waste any of her Master's time.
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: What say you to going without an itinerary?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Trips with the Rose Clan are always meticulously planned
from dawn to dusk.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, it wasn't bad.
And yet, there were moments when I felt this way.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I sometimes wonder what it feels like
to stroll through the city just like the aimless travelers
I occasionally pass by.
And so, that was how it went.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Drawn by the aroma, one can dine to one's heart's content, pausing to lose oneself in the scenery.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To me, this is truly
beyond the realm of the everyday.

For Rose Kingdom, the young monarch of the Rose Clan
who carries so much upon her shoulders—

Wandering wherever whim takes you
is indeed a rare luxury, I imagine.
choice_data_list: 本日は目いっぱい、楽しみましょう
choice_data_list_en: Let's enjoy today to the absolute fullest.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, thank you.
I believe I shall take you up on that.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...What a truly breathtaking view.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Shall we rest a while?
Beneath the shade of that tree—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A regional specialty pudding, is it?
That seems quite fitting for today's weather.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Did I perhaps overeat a little?
choice_data_list: 『気の赴くままの、あてどない旅』では？
choice_data_list_en: How about "an aimless journey, wherever the mood takes you"?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Very well.
All right, I shall have one.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Have I kept you waiting?
choice_data_list: いえ、たった今参りました
choice_data_list_en: No, I have only just arrived.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I see. I am glad.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I have a suggestion, if you would hear it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It seems this inn has an adjoining footbath.
Shall we go take a look?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: A footbath has a distinctive charm of its own, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—A thought crossed my mind just now.
That I wished to enjoy the hot springs beside you as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There was a footbath right by the storefront...
Fortune smiled upon me, I must say.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Wandering without a destination has quite grown on you, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Still, it seems our journey is nearing its close.

I checked the small wall clock.
Indeed, the time to head home was drawing near.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Would you care to come here again, just the two of us?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I am the bearer of the Rose Clan's legacy.
That is something which, in all likelihood, will never change.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I take immense pride in this duty.
To fulfill our long-cherished wish for the sake of my house is my truest joy.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: And yet.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The time spent like this with you here
has warmed my heart unexpectedly.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I want to come again.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It does not need to be frequent.
Just whenever the opportunity arises, or whenever the thought crosses your mind.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I simply wish to share
a gentle, boundless stretch of time together.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...If it is with you.

It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable
bond between Rose Kingdom and myself...
